# Track OKF Specification Version

This feature tracks the specific version of the OKF specification targeted by each compilation's wiki emission. The 'okf_spec_version' column is added to the 'compile_runs' table to support version management alongside existing version pairs. This allows for better tracking and adherence to specification changes over time.
